messages:
alex: quick heads-up: product wants per-route embedding stats in console. i'm proposing we add a new nullable column `embeddings_v1` to console_events and ship quantized vectors in the event envelope.

morgan: can we avoid inflating the row size across the entire table? embedding arrays for every event could be heavy.

alex: plan is to keep it nullable and default null, dual-write only for routes opted into the experiment. also use compressed f16 blobs to keep delta small.

samir: if we need later similarity search, pgvector or an external vector service is better. storing as jsonb limits index usage. do we plan kNN at query time?

alex: not immediately. targets: anomaly detection, partition-level clustering, and some dashboard charts. kNN would be a future enhancement.

priya: dashboards: any materialized views that aggregate event size will need to be updated. propose adding a safety flag to prevent ingestion spikes from breaking panels.

morgan: suggested schema changes: ALTER TABLE console_events ADD COLUMN embeddings_v1 bytea DEFAULT NULL; CREATE INDEX idx_console_events_has_embeddings ON console_events((embeddings_v1 IS NOT NULL));

samir: bytea + compression looks good. we should also add an envelope field `emb_profile` enum to indicate qtype: raw_f32 | f16_comp | int8_scaled. read adapters must check this.

alex: yes, adapter will write profile and length. sample envelope: {profile: "f16_comp", dims: 128, data: <base64>} and UI will show vector_available flag.

priya: QA asks: 1) retention cost delta, 2) p95/p99 producer latency impact, 3) dashboard smoke queries. we need runbook entries for rollback if retention or UI errors spike.

ingest-bot: canary scheduled: window=2024-06-12T02:00Z..2024-06-12T05:00Z; alerts: ingestion-latency > 5% or storage-growth > 3% in that window.

morgan: i'll run a sim with last week's payloads and the f16 quantization to estimate storage delta and post numbers today.

samir: i'll prototype the dual-write change in the runtime adapter and add feature-flag gating. will include unit tests for profile propagation.

priya: i'll add dashboard guards: a gating transform that ignores embeddings for size metrics unless feature-flag active. also create a smoke test comparing route-level ingest sizes before/after.

alex: backfill: default forward-only. if product needs historical vectors, we offer an opt-in backfill job for a 7d window with throttling. note cost implications.

morgan: migration steps I propose: 1) schema add + index, 2) adapter dual-write behind feature flag, 3) 1% traffic canary -> 5% -> 25%, 4) evaluate cost + decide on separate vector index if query needs emerge, 5) full rollout.

priya: add a console UI fallback: when embeddings missing show "embedding not collected" and ensure aggregation code tolerates nulls.

alex: action items: morgan -> storage/cost sim; samir -> dual-write PR; priya -> runbook + dashboard smoke tests; infra/ingest-bot -> schedule canary and alerts.

morgan: got it, will post numbers by EOD.

samir: starting the branch now. will label feature-flag `embeddings_ingest` and link tests.

alex: cool. if no objections we'll open the schema PR tomorrow. thumbs up to proceed. :thumbsup:
